name: Elder Obsidian
summary: Elder Obsidian is an ancestral earthen spirit who manifests at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest during the annual Lunar Festival. Appearing among the graves claimed by the Forsaken, he offers the wisdom and blessings of the ancient world to travelers honoring the festival.

sections.title: A Spirit at the Sepulcher
sections.body: Standing amid the somber tombs of the Sepulcher, Elder Obsidian provides a striking contrast to Silverpine Forest's gloomy expanse. As an ethereal earthen elder, his spirit manifests during the Lunar Festival to celebrate the ancient heritage of Azeroth. While the surrounding crypts are held by the Forsaken and menaced by feral worgen, Obsidian greets wayfarers of all allegiances in peace, bestowing Coin of Ancestry and ancient blessings upon those who take the time to seek out his wisdom.

faq.answer: Elder Obsidian is an ancient earthen ghost who appears in Silverpine Forest. He surfaces exclusively during the Lunar Festival, greeting travelers who honor the world's ancestral heritage.

faq.q: Where can Elder Obsidian be found?
faq.answer: He can be found resting within the graveyard grounds of the Sepulcher, a Forsaken-controlled hamlet situated along the road in central Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does an earthen elder appear in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, the spirits of ancient elders manifest in lands across Azeroth to share their ancestral wisdom. Obsidian's spiritual presence transcends local territorial conflicts, allowing him to commune quietly amidst the ancient graves.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers speak with Elder Obsidian?
faq.answer: Yes. Festival elders remain neutral toward all travelers regardless of faction. However, because he rests in the Sepulcher, Alliance adventurers must carefully navigate the hostile Forsaken guards stationed nearby to reach him.

angles.text: For dwarves curious about their Titan-forged lineage, speaking with an earthen spirit like Elder Obsidian offers a rare glimpse into the primordial past of their stone-hewn ancestors.
Alliance pilgrims seeking Elder Obsidian must tread carefully, as his chosen resting place lies in the heart of the Forsaken settlement of the Sepulcher.
